task: AG-05 Recovery State Machine Final Closed-Loop & Negative Verification

assertions.drill: Drill 1: MacServer Local Business Shutdown & HTTP 403 Assertion
assertions.details: tunnel-ctl.sh orchestrated-stop persisted EVENTKIT_BRIDGE_PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED=false to bridge.env, reloaded bridge, verified /reminders/lists returned HTTP 403 PERMISSION_DENIED, verified /health still returned 200, and stopped supervisor while preserving bridge loopback listener.

assertions.drill: Drill 2: Local Session Hard Deadline Watchdog & Crash-Resistant Persistence
assertions.details: run-resident-tunnel.sh persisted DEADLINE_EPOCH in session_deadline.env; supervisor killed with SIGKILL, restarted, verified deadline epoch was not reset; upon deadline expiration, local watchdog executed orchestrated-stop, setting bridge.env to false and returning 403 on /reminders/lists; subsequent startup correctly rejected.

assertions.drill: Drill 3: Cross-Device Network Disconnect (Failsafe & Failure Aggregation)
assertions.details: orchestrated-recovery.sh executed with unreachable remote SSH target; remote status recorded as UNKNOWN_PENDING_VERIFICATION (not falsely claimed closed); Seoul local container and config rollback completed; script aggregated remote error, output [RECOVERY_FAILED], and exited with code 1.

assertions.drill: Drill 4: Task Process Cleanup with Zero Collateral Damage
assertions.details: orchestrated-recovery.sh terminated PID-verified task tunnel process; unrelated background process remained running and unaffected; verified port 19765 listener removed without indiscriminate killing.

assertions.drill: Drill 5: Concurrent Recovery Idempotency & Mutual Exclusion
assertions.details: Two simultaneous orchestrated-recovery.sh processes invoked on the same backup directory; .rollback.lock mutual exclusion prevented race condition; both completed idempotently with exit code 0.
Manifest indicated 60-macserver-gateway.conf was created by task and did not pre-exist; 60- was removed while pre-existing 50-preexisting.conf was preserved intact (no unconditional deletion).

assertions.drill: Drill 7: Partial Step Failure Aggregation & Non-Zero Exit Guarantee
assertions.details: Injected health check failure in Step 5; orchestrated-recovery.sh executed best-effort steps, collected error in recovery_errors, output [RECOVERY_FAILED], never output [RECOVERY-SUCCESS], and exited with code 1.

assertions.drill: Drill 8: Concurrent Recovery Failure Propagation (Negative Concurrency)
assertions.details: Two concurrent recovery processes where first run failed; waiting second process verified recovery_result.json, detected failure, refused to return 0, output [RECOVERY_FAILED], and both exited with code 1.

When MacServer was unconfigured, production-entry.sh deploy blocked deployment immediately before any changes (exit 1); orchestrated-recovery.sh recorded status as NOT_CONFIGURED, logged critical error, output [RECOVERY_FAILED], and exited non-zero.

assertions.drill: Drill 10: Container Stop Failure Safety Barrier
assertions.details: Candidate container refused to stop; orchestrated-recovery.sh engaged [SAFETY_BARRIER], skipped rsync configuration overwrite to protect runtime data, skipped docker compose up baseline, and exited non-zero.

assertions.drill: Drill 11: Precise Process Attribution & Zero Collateral Damage
assertions.details: Unrelated processes with matching names ('EventKitBridgeServer --unrelated-session' and unrelated SSH session) ran alongside verified task tunnel process; orchestrated-recovery.sh cleanly terminated task process while unrelated processes remained alive and completely unharmed.

assertions.drill: Drill 12: Local Business Close Failure Traceability
assertions.details: Simulated orchestrated-stop failure (exit 42) on deadline watchdog expiry; run-resident-tunnel.sh persisted RECOVERY_FAILED=1 and STOP_EXIT_CODE=42 in local_recovery_status.env; preserved status as failed_stop_error rather than masking as clean 'stopped'.

assertions.drill: Drill 13: SSH Authorized Keys Fidelity (All 3 Cases)
assertions.details: Case A (preexisted=0): candidate added key cleanly removed; Case B (preexisted=1): pre-existing authorized_keys faithfully restored with 0600 permissions; Case C (custom path): restored to custom path specified in manifest with 0600 permissions.
